blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The registered owner of a motorcycle used in the fatal shooting of a pharmacist here faces a 90-day preventive suspension of their driver’s license. This follows an administrative investigation launched by the Land Transportation Office in Central Visayas (LTO-7) over the vehicle’s involvement in the crime. LTO-7 issued a show cause order on Wednesday, November 11, directing the registered owner to surrender their driver’s license and explain why they should not face administrative liability following the November 10 killing of 40-year-old pharmacist Marjorie Llaguno along V.
